Vineeth Krishna Talasila · Publishing as **Vineeth Krishna**

Postdoctoral researcher in theoretical physics at the University of Michigan. My interests include quantum gravity, holography, multipartite entanglement, supergravity, and string theory.

## Academic appointments

### University of Michigan

[2024–present · Postdoctoral researcher]{.entry-meta}

Leinweber Institute for Theoretical Physics, Ann Arbor, Michigan. Research on black hole phases, holography, and quantum information in gravity.

### Tata Institute of Fundamental Research

[2019–2024 · Doctoral researcher]{.entry-meta}

Department of Theoretical Physics, Mumbai, India. Research on measures of multipartite entanglement and their holographic descriptions, with analytical and numerical calculations in Mathematica and Python.

### California Institute of Technology

[May–July 2017 · Summer research fellow, LIGO Laboratory]{.entry-meta}

Studied coating Brownian noise and developed a digital phase-locked loop on an FPGA for the experimental setup.

## Methods & tools

**Programming and scientific computing:** Mathematica, Python (NumPy, SciPy), C++, MATLAB, SageMath, LaTeX, Linux, and Git.

**Mathematical and numerical methods:** Linear algebra, differential equations, information theory, convex optimization, semidefinite programming, stochastic processes, and spectral analysis.

## Earlier research

**Everyday Radio Telescope · IISER Thiruvananthapuram (2016).** Built a radio telescope with fellow students and worked on signal acquisition and spectral analysis. [Read the project paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.02982).
